execution_policy: Registered calibration profile and weighted log-odds only; independent hypothesis estimates, no cross-hypothesis normalization or autonomous decisions.

cases.scenario: Validated registered calibration profile, exact inference/premise bindings, and source-backed fact evidence with bounded weights and reliability.
cases.expected: Bounded posterior and normalized entropy with reproducible calculation digest.

cases.scenario: Calibration profile is unvalidated, expired, substituted, missing its dataset digest or outside policy bounds.
cases.expected: No calibrated posterior; all evidence disposition is explicit.

cases.scenario: Evidence is an assumption, hypothesis or unknown rather than a source-backed fact.
cases.expected: Evidence remains unresolved and does not affect the posterior.

cases.scenario: Evidence source digest is malformed, observation time is future/noncanonical, or validity has expired.
cases.expected: Evidence remains unresolved; no stale/future evidence influence.

cases.scenario: Weights/reliability are nonfinite/out of range, duplicate IDs exist or likelihood ratios are invalid.
Inference ID, premise-set digest, method version, calculation method or calibration profile digest is substituted.
cases.expected: Reject calculation and emit no calibrated probability.

cases.scenario: Support and refutation evidence coexist for a hypothesis.
cases.expected: Preserve both counts and explicitly flag evidence_conflict; do not silently discard either side.
